description: Search eMAG products, browse a category, fetch one product, or list every seller offer. Romania, Bulgaria and Hungary storefronts; no account or cookies needed.

categoryUrl.description: eMAG category URL or path, e.g. /laptopuri/c or https://www.emag.ro/laptopuri/c (mode=browseCategory). Use a path from the selected market.
categoryUrl.title: Category URL

inStockOnly.description: Keep only products that can be ordered right now.
inStockOnly.title: In stock only

includeOffers.description: For mode=getProductDetails, add the buybox and competing seller offers to each product record. Ignored by the other modes.
includeOffers.title: Include seller offers

market.description: Which eMAG storefront to use. A full product or category URL overrides this value.
market.title: Market

maxItems.description: Maximum products to return for searchProducts and browseCategory (1-1000). Detail and offers modes return one product or all of its offers.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Keep products at or below this price in the market's currency.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

minPrice.description: Keep products at or above this price in the market's currency (RON, EUR or HUF).
minPrice.title: Minimum price

minRating.description: Keep products rated at least this many stars. Products with no rating are excluded when a minimum is set.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: What to scrape: a keyword search, a category page, one product, or the seller offers for one product.
enumTitles: Get every seller offer for one product
mode.title: Mode

productUrl.description: Full eMAG product URL, a path containing /pd/, or a product code such as DR3HHTYBM (mode=getProductDetails or getProductOffers).
productUrl.title: Product URL or code

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for (mode=searchProducts). Use the market's language for the best results.
query.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Result order for searchProducts and browseCategory. Reviews and discount are eMAG's own server-side sorts.
sortBy.title: Sort by

title: eMAG Scraper Input
